name: wfuzz
summary: Utility to bruteforce web applications to find their not linked resources.
highlights: --recipe — : Reads options from a recipe. Repeat for various recipes.
--dump-recipe — : Prints current options as a recipe
--oF — : Saves fuzz results to a file. These can be consumed later using the wfuzz payload.
--interact — : (beta) If selected,all key presses are captured. This allows you to interact with the pr
--dry-run — : Print the results of applying the requests without actually making any HTTP request.

flags.name: --help
flags.description: : This help

flags.name: --filter-help
flags.description: : Filter language specification

flags.name: --version
flags.description: : Wfuzz version details

flags.name: -e
flags.description: : List of available encoders/payloads/iterators/printers/scripts

flags.name: --recipe
flags.description: : Reads options from a recipe. Repeat for various recipes.

flags.name: --dump-recipe
flags.description: : Prints current options as a recipe

flags.name: --oF
flags.description: : Saves fuzz results to a file. These can be consumed later using the wfuzz payload.

flags.name: -c
flags.description: : Output with colors

flags.name: -v
flags.description: : Verbose information.

flags.name: --interact
flags.description: : (beta) If selected,all key presses are captured. This allows you to interact with the program.

flags.name: --dry-run
flags.description: : Print the results of applying the requests without actually making any HTTP request.

flags.name: --prev
flags.description: : Print the previous HTTP requests (only when using payloads generating fuzzresults)

flags.name: --efield
flags.description: : Show the specified language expression together with the current payload. Repeat for various fields.

flags.name: --field
flags.description: : Do not show the payload but only the specified language expression. Repeat for various fields.

flags.name: -t
flags.description: : Specify the number of concurrent connections (10 default)

flags.name: -s
flags.description: : Specify time delay between requests (0 default)

flags.name: --follow
flags.description: : Follow HTTP redirections

flags.name: -Z
flags.description: : Scan mode (Connection errors will be ignored).

flags.name: --req-delay
flags.description: : Sets the maximum time in seconds the request is allowed to take (CURLOPT_TIMEOUT). Default 90.

flags.name: --conn-delay
flags.description: : Sets the maximum time in seconds the connection phase to the server to take (CURLOPT_CONNECTTIMEOUT). Default 90.

flags.name: --AA
flags.description: : Alias for -v -c and --script=default,verbose,discover respectively

flags.name: --no-cache
flags.description: : Disable plugins cache. Every request will be scanned.

flags.name: --script
flags.description: : Runs script's scan. <plugins> is a comma separated list of plugin-files or plugin-categories

flags.name: --script-help
flags.description: : Show help about scripts.

flags.name: -u
flags.description: : Specify a URL for the request.

flags.name: --zP
flags.description: : Arguments for the specified payload (it must be preceded by -z or -w).

flags.name: --zD
flags.description: : Default parameter for the specified payload (it must be preceded by -z or -w).

flags.name: --zE
flags.description: : Encoder for the specified payload (it must be preceded by -z or -w).

flags.name: --slice
flags.description: : Filter payload's elements using the specified expression. It must be preceded by -z.

flags.name: --filter
flags.description: : Show/hide responses using the specified filter expression (Use BBB for taking values from baseline)

flags.name: --prefilter
flags.description: : Filter items before fuzzing using the specified expression. Repeat for concatenating filters.
